name: claudeconnect
notes: Slash commands: type / in the message box and a list of every command opens above it, with what each is for. It narrows as you type, by name and by description. Use the arrows to move, Tab to fill a name in, Enter to run, and Esc to close.

Claude Code's commands run in the chat, the way they do in the terminal: /compact, /context, /init, /review and the rest, plus your skills, plugins and your own commands from .claude/commands. The list comes from the Claude Code on your computer, so it shows exactly what you have.
/context comes back as a bar showing how full the conversation is and what fills it.
A few work right in the site: /clear (new chat), /model, /effort, /usage, /config, /permissions, /files, /rename and /help.
